## Gear Street Gang Member (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
 Auttaine brawler 3/rogue 3  
 N Medium humanoid (half-construct, human)  
 **Init** +6; **Senses** Perception +8  

**Defense**

 **AC** 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+3 armor, +2 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 natural)  
 **hp** 43 each (6 HD; 3d8+3d10+9)  
 **Fort** +5, **Ref** +8, **Will** +1; +2 bonus vs. disease, mind-affecting effects, poison, and fatigue or exhaustion effects.  

 Defensive Abilities evasion, trap sense +1; **Resist** construct resistance  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** scizore +9 (1d10+3) or scizore flurry of blows +6/+6 (1d10+3) or unarmed strike +8 (1d6+3) or unarmed strike flurry of blows +6/+6 (1d6+3)  
 **Ranged** revolver +8 (1d8/x4)  
 **Special Attacks** brawler’s flurry, breath weapon (1/day: acid—15-ft. cone, 2d6 [DC 13]), maneuver training (grapple +1), martial flexibility 4/day, sneak attack +2d6 +2 bleed  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 16, **Dex** 15, **Con** 13, **Int** 9, **Wis** 9, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +8 (+9 grapple); **CMD** 21 (22 vs. grapple)  
 **Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed Strike, [Weapon Focus (scizore)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (scizore), Toughness.*  
 **Skills** Bluff +5, Climb +12, Intimidate +9, Knowledge (local) +4, Perception +8, Stealth +11  
 **Languages** Common  
 **SQ** brawler’s cunning, build points (5—breath weapon (extra damage), natural armor, hidden storage compartment), martial training, rogue talent (bleeding attack +2), trapfinding +1  
 **Combat Gear** inferno grenade, potion of cure light wounds; **Other Gear** Masterwork omniweave armor, revolver with 12 metal cartridges, scizore
